item.title: Three abstracts at OHBM 2026 — Bordeaux
item.description: This June I attended the Organization for Human Brain Mapping (OHBM) Annual Meeting 2026 in Bordeaux, France, where I participated in three abstracts spanning spinal cord foundation modelling, resting-state functional connectivity, and proprioceptive circuit mapping. All abstracts are browsable through the Abstract Atlas — an interactive 3D embedding of every OHBM 2026 submission where each dot is an abstract, positioned by semantic similarity.
